name: Trishakti Industries Ltd
tagline: Small-cap infra-capex play that pivoted from electronics into pure-play heavy-equipment (crane) leasing, with explosive FY26 growth but a very short track record and heavy debtor days.
business_overview: Trishakti Industries Ltd (BSE: 531279, formerly Trishakti Electronics and Industries) has repositioned itself as an infrastructure-solutions provider, buying heavy earth-moving equipment (primarily cranes) and leasing it on a project basis to large infrastructure contractors, riding India's ongoing infra capex cycle. Seeded 2026-09-13 via untrusted X triage (@13gaurdevesh, bullish/high-conviction).
fundamentals_table: FY26 revenue +90% YoY; EBITDA +220% YoY; Q3 FY26 EBITDA margin ~70%
fundamentals_narrative: The pivot to a pure-play equipment-leasing model has produced a genuinely sharp growth inflection (fleet utilisation at 100%, revenue +90% YoY, EBITDA +220% YoY, ~70% EBITDA margins in Q3 FY26), and the infra capex tailwind behind it is real. But two things temper it: debtor days of ~206 are high for a leasing business and point to working-capital/collection risk with project-based infra clients, and the ~38.6x trailing P/E already prices in a large chunk of the turnaround story before it has a multi-year track record.
